industry.description: Key data by ANZSIC subdivision and division, FY2022-23 to FY2024-25 (8155.0 Table 1). level: subdivision, division (the ABS division total) or total (all selected industries). Finance and insurance covers subdivision 64 only; divisions O, P and Q are private sector only. Employment is at end of June.
